entries.title: Jeremiah 36:2
segments:
vv 2-3. 
 
All God's dealings with his people are marked by sincerity and openness; he multiplies his endeavors to bring them to repentance, and sends not his chastisements upon them until he has abundantly warned them of their approach.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:5
segments:
vv 5-6. 
 
Outward constraint does not hinder the faithful servant of God from continuing his labors as he has opportunity; and a prison has often afforded a most profitable field of activity.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:8
segments: They who are not themselves preachers can often render most important aid to those who hold this office; and it is their duty to do so as they have opportunity.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:9
segments: In the fifth year--in the ninth month; this delay of so many months seems to have had for its object to secure the most convenient time for reading the roll.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:16
segments:
Were afraid both one and other; literally, "they feared one to another;" that is, looked upon one another with astonishment and fear. 
 
vv 16-19. 
 
The workings of conscience in the minds of irreligious men often second the preachers of the truth in so powerful a way that they are willing, to a certain extent, to countenance their labors and protect them from their enemies.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:19
segments: Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; though Jeremiah was under some sort of confinement,
, yet with the favor and countenance of the princes, it would be easy for him and Baruch to secrete themselves.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:22
segments:
In the ninth month; answering nearly to our January. 
 
  A fire on the hearth burning; more exactly, "the pot was burning before him."  The people of the East warm their rooms by means of a pot containing burning wood or charcoal.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:23
segments:
Leaves; that is, columns into which the roll was divided. 
 
vv 23-26. 
 
Men in high stations, who are fully set in their sinful ways, will not bear faithful reproof; but will, so far as lies in their power, persecute its preachers, and destroy both them and their messages.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:27
segments:
vv 27-31. 
 
Opposition to God's awful threatenings cannot hinder their execution; it can only provoke his anger, and involve us in deeper ruin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:30
segments: None to sit upon the throne of David; his son Jechoniah reigned only three months, and he had no successor of his own children.  See note on

entries.title: Jeremiah 36:32
segments: In all ages of the world, wicked rulers and false teachers have combined to suppress and hinder the knowledge of God's word.  But he will in the final issue overthrow all who array themselves against it, and give it free course through the earth.
